title: Chapter 1863: Liyuan Theater (I)
content:
Chapter 1863: Liyuan Theater (I)

The Western Sea...

The name was familiar to Li Suining. For a moment, it even left him dazed. In his second life, Li Zhouwei had come to consult him as well. Back then, however, he had not spent a year unconscious. He had visited Li Xuanxuan and attended to matters on the western shore. When the King of Wei had come with his question, Li Suining had found himself in an awkward position.

Neither Li Zhouwei nor Li Ximing had made this journey to the Western Sea in his first life. Li Ximing had suffered a serious setback there earlier on, but a turn of circumstances had prevented this later trip. Li Zhouwei had not slain Guangchan, and was still recovering from his injuries during this period.

Now, however, the situation was entirely different. After much consideration back then, he had ultimately advised them to proceed.

Western Shu and the Xiangxiong Kingdom are locked in fierce fighting. The Western Sea, Poluoduo, and even Longdi and the western desert have all been drawn into the upheaval. There is unrest everywhere, but also opportunities to profit from the chaos.

Thus, Li Ximing and Li Zhouwei had traveled to the Western Sea to obtain Wall-Sinking Water. At the time, Li Suining had not yet taken charge of the grotto heaven, and only Li Zhouwei had trusted him with his secret. Though he did not know the details, he had heard nothing of either man returning injured.

With their current combined strength, Daoist Master Zhaojing and the King of Wei may not be able to act unchallenged across the mainland, where prodigies abound. But in that remote region, few can afford to cross them!

After all, the Western Sea was small and difficult to traverse by wind. It was hardly suitable for juniors to cultivate in, being only somewhat better than the outer-sea. What sort of people holed up there? It was only those like Yangya, with no ambition to seek the Dao or concern for a sect, wishing only to shut themselves away and rule their own little domain. Or those like Qingyan, who had offended powerful figures or cultivated forbidden methods and dared not show themselves elsewhere.

As for the scattered cultivators of lower realms, most were devil cultivators. In other words, this time Li Suining could tell Li Zhouwei with genuine certainty that the journey to the Western Sea would end well!

Moreover, years later, Li Suining had seen Li Quewan take out [Profound Coffin Crimson Water] in the secret realm to cultivate an art and suppress her injuries.

He had then heard her lament,

The Daoist Master refined this water in the Western Sea. Unfortunately, I had not yet emerged from seclusion and could not assist him. It lacked a measure of Treasure Earth to harmonize Water and Wood. Had that measure been added, I could have found some way to set it right... But alas... it is flawed at its very foundation.

Li Suining had asked her then,

Refined in the Western Sea... Was it made using the [Supplementary Court Verdant Profound Cauldron] you possess, aunt?

Li Quewan had nodded,

That rogue cultivator Yinxin is thoroughly deceitful. He took a spirit item back with him, yet of the [Manifest Shore White Blossoms] he promised, he has delivered only one to this day. He claims the spiritual aura has changed. We ought to settle accounts with him. If he refuses to see reason, we might as well fell that spirit root!

Li Suining knew something of the latter matter as well. An agreement had been made with a cultivator in the Western Sea, but after a change in the region's spiritual aura, the man began making excuses and stopped sending the promised goods to the lake. Whether his claims were true, Li Suining did not know. By then, tensions between north and south had been stretched taut as a bowstring, leaving them no time to deal with a cultivator in the Western Sea.

Perhaps that rogue cultivator saw that our family could not spare anyone to collect what he owed in the Western Sea... That is why he kept stalling, making excuses, and sending no one.

He carefully gathered his thoughts and replied, "This venture is highly auspicious, but it lacks Earth. Judging by what my mystics reveal, it should involve refining a spirit item. It would be best to add a measure of Treasure Earth."

The precision of his words brought a thoughtful look to Li Zhouwei's face. "A measure of Treasure Earth..."

Li Suining immediately understood his meaning. He could only regret not asking Li Quewan exactly how much that supposed measure of Treasure Earth was.

From now on, I must ask about every detail... Then I will not find myself in this predicament again...

Li Zhouwei, however, quickly worked it out and replied, "I understand. So there are considerations beyond simply adding spirit items. Let us do this... If any spirit items need refining, we should postpone it if possible, preferably until Quewan emerges from seclusion. If it truly cannot wait, I will judge how much Treasure Earth to add."

Li Suining's eyes lit up. Moving the documents aside, he picked up the teapot and poured tea for Li Zhouwei as he said, "That is the first matter... The second should involve dividing the yield of a spirit root. A change in the spiritual aura may cause complications. I hope the Daoist Master can settle everything in one go. Even if it means squandering a natural treasure... fell the tree and take its materials..."

The look in Li Zhouwei's eyes grew more pronounced. "Very well."

He accepted the tea and nodded slightly. After a long while, he said, "Heavenly Plain is quite remarkable... No wonder Senior Changdie prospered so well back then despite being a rogue cultivator..."

Li Suining could only lower his head, his feelings tangled. "I cannot compare with him..."

Then he noticed Li Zhouwei studying him, golden eyes gleaming. "Are you injured?"

How perceptive Li Zhouwei's eyes were! One glance was enough to reveal damage to Li Suining's foundations and a loss of lifespan. This was no trivial matter!

Purple Mansion Realm cultivators spoke of nature and life; those below that realm were more familiar with the term 'foundations.' Such damage usually followed a narrow escape from a battle to the death or some devastating injury. Once sustained, it was difficult to repair and could easily impair future cultivation and breakthroughs!

The injury Li Xuanxuan had suffered in the market town years ago had shortened his lifespan and left lasting harm. Li Suining's condition, however, was stranger still. To Li Zhouwei, it looked as though he had lost a considerable portion of his allotted life. Much of the toll his body should otherwise have borne seemed to have been paid on his behalf by Heavenly Plain's favor.

Damage to one's allotted life was grave and irreversible. For practitioners of the Purple-Gold Devil Dao, there was virtually no remedy unless they surrendered their true spirit to a Buddhist land, became its dependent, and switched to another Dao. Only a handful of divine abilities could extend it somewhat.

Serious though it is, at least it has little effect on his cultivation... I wonder whether Senior Changdie suffered the same. Since he managed to reach the Purple Mansion Realm... even if he did, it must have been this kind, with little effect on his progress...

Countless thoughts passed through Li Zhouwei’s mind in that brief moment. Li Suining paused at the question, then remembered the blood he had coughed up upon waking.

He hastily smiled and shook his head. "It hardly counts as an injury! Just a slight mishap in my cultivation..."

Li Zhouwei frowned. What sort of mishap could damage one's nature and life and shorten one's lifespan? Recalling Li Suining’s time in seclusion and how naturally he had responded to the mention of Liu Changdie, he soon arrived at an answer.

When I asked him about Heavenly Plain back then, he knew nothing of it. Now he seems thoroughly familiar with it...

Yet Li Zhouwei did not expose him. Instead, he said quietly, "Do not rush for immediate gains... Take your time... with this."

Li Suining's heart trembled. Looking into those golden eyes, he found himself at a loss for words. An unspoken meaning entered Li Zhouwei's voice as he smiled. "[Heaven-Governing] works through Heaven's calculations. You and I make our own. Which will prevail? We will only know once we put it to the test."
